{"title":"Invoices: add PDF download","brief":"Owner request (13/10/2026): "Add a PDF download for invoices." Build it so the owner can download a PDF of an invoice from the Invoices page.

Context:
- Small Node 20 + TypeScript app. src/web/server.ts is a plain node:http server: `/invoices` (the default route) renders an HTML table with one hardcoded invoice ("Invoice 1", lines [{quantity: 2, unitPrice: 12.50}]), and its total comes from invoiceTotalCents in src/invoices/index.ts. `/customers` and `/api/customers` also exist.
- src/invoices/index.ts exports Line, lineTotalCents, invoiceTotalCents and invoiceDate (en-GB format).
- Read AGENTS.md first. Never run scripts/owner-only.sh.
- Project convention: dates in the UI are always DD/MM/YYYY, and that applies to the PDF too.
- Other open PRs may touch the same files: the invoice-totals off-by-a-cent fix (PR #4) and the customers CSV export (PR #5). Do not redo their work. If you hit conflicts, keep your change minimal and rebase-friendly.

What to build:
1. Add a per-invoice "Download PDF" link or button in each row of the Invoices table. Use a text label, not an emoji.
2. Add a route such as GET /invoices/:id/pdf that returns a valid PDF with Content-Type application/pdf and Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="invoice-<id>.pdf". Unknown ids return 404.
3. The PDF shows the invoice number, the date (DD/MM/YYYY), each line (quantity, unit price, line total) and the invoice total. Amounts are formatted with 2 decimals, and the total uses invoiceTotalCents, so totals match the HTML page exactly.
4. Keep the invoice data in one place: the page and the PDF must read the same source, not two hardcoded copies.
5. Choose the PDF approach on quality and maintainability. A well-maintained library (e.g. pdfkit or pdf-lib) or a small hand-written PDF generator are both acceptable; justify the choice in the report. Avoid headless-browser dependencies for this.

Tests and checks:
- Unit tests (vitest) for PDF generation: it starts with %PDF-, and it contains or renders the expected total and date.
- Playwright browser test in tests/browser/invoices.spec.ts: clicking Download PDF triggers a download with the right filename and a non-empty PDF body.
- `npm run lint`, `npm test`, and `npm run check:changelog` all pass. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry.

Done means:
- Start the app as a managed app with jevellan_app_start, verify in a real browser that the button appears, the download works and the PDF opens with correct content, and return the verified browser link so the owner can try it.
